assets.label: 竞技斜切
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: full-screen material plate for an animated vertical video transition, not a storyboard.
Primary request: A premium sports motion-design transition plate: sweeping diagonal ribbons of brushed graphite, warm ivory and a restrained electric vermilion accent. Macro silkscreen grain, finely embossed athletic-fabric texture, sculptural folded ribbon depth, decisive parallel diagonal rhythm, restrained editorial composition. Strong large shapes, no tiny clutter. Crisp tactile printcraft meets broadcast sports art direction.
Composition: portrait 9:16, edge-to-edge opaque artwork, premium professional motion studio finish. One single cohesive abstract composition. Material detail should remain beautiful at 720x1280. This texture will be revealed through an animated wipe mask, not used as a title background.
Constraints: no text, letters, numerals, logos, watermark, people, sports balls, interface, frames, borders, collage or multiple panels. Deliver a single full-bleed portrait image.
